market.question: Will the highest temperature in Atlanta be between 70-71°F on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Atlanta Hartsfield April 30 (today) forecast shows a high of ~74°F per AccuWeather/local sources, with cloudy skies and chance of rain shower. The market wants the high to land in the 70-71°F bucket specifically (a 2-degree window). With forecast at 74°F, probability of landing 2-3°F lower is modest, maybe 10-15%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cloud cover and rain shower could suppress the daily high more than forecast — but a precise 2°F bucket hit is a narrow target.
